'''Pa Dua'''<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Aide/Legends|aide]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|213|Dua, Pa}}</ref> who served<ref name="Depth" /> the corrupt representative of<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|onacondafarr|Farr, Onaconda}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]],<ref name="DB" /> [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]],<ref name="Depth" /> in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Dua held the role<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
"Pa" was a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] Rodian name translating to "late." "Dua," another feminine name, translated to "sharp-[[Tongue/Legends|tongued]]."<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
